scope: Network primitives, queues, vectors, recording output, header construction, and playback map/camera support

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkRecordDecoder_PeekCurrent
applied.evidence: Returns the current framed network replay record without consuming it, including the 0x40000000 control-record representation.

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkTransport_PollConnect
applied.evidence: Polls asynchronous connection progress, completes the alternate handle path, and returns pending, connected, or failed status.

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkTransport_FlushSendBuffer
applied.evidence: Sends queued bytes on a connected nonblocking socket, compacts the remainder, and performs a write-side shutdown when requested.

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkTransport_Receive
applied.evidence: Receives into the transport buffer and distinguishes progress, would-block, orderly close, and fatal socket errors.

applied.name: KWReplayNetwork_ReadU16LE
applied.evidence: Loads a little-endian 16-bit protocol value from two unaligned bytes.

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkRecordDecoder_Reset
applied.evidence: Clears the decoder's buffered, staged, and consumed byte counts and the reader's current-record-valid flag.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_CloseFileSource
applied.evidence: For file source mode, closes the active replay stream through the common optional-footer close path.

applied.name: ReplayVoiceQueue_PeekFront
applied.evidence: Returns the first voice queue payload and synchronizes the cached iterator without unlinking it.

applied.name: ReplayVoiceQueue_PopFront
applied.evidence: Unlinks and returns the first voice queue payload, or null for an empty queue.

applied.name: ReplayVoiceQueue_InsertBefore
applied.evidence: Allocates a voice-stream node and links it before the supplied list node.

applied.name: ReplayTelestratorQueue_InsertBefore
applied.evidence: Allocates a telestrator-stream node and links it before the supplied node.

applied.name: ReplayMetadataQueue_InsertBefore
applied.evidence: Allocates a metadata-stream node and links it before the supplied node.

applied.name: ReplayCameraQueue_InsertBefore
applied.evidence: Allocates a camera-stream node and links it before the supplied node.

applied.name: ReplayGameCommandQueue_InsertBefore
applied.evidence: Allocates a game-command batch node and links it before the supplied node.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_AreScheduledChannelsReady
applied.evidence: Gets the due channel schedule and confirms that every listed channel queue contains a record before current-frame dispatch.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_ClearConfiguredQueues
applied.evidence: Walks the configured channel order and clears the corresponding command, voice, telestrator, metadata, camera, and control queues.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EncodeScheduledChannelsForFrame
applied.evidence: Encodes mandatory control channels and each configured replay channel for the supplied logic frame while updating per-channel schedule state.

applied.name: ReplayRecordingOptions_CopyFrom
applied.evidence: Performs the field-aware copy of the 204-byte replay recording options, including owned strings and embedded slot data.

applied.name: ReplayVersion_Parse
applied.evidence: Parses the four decimal components of a dotted replay version string.

applied.name: GameMessageVector_Reserve
applied.evidence: Grows a vector in 132-byte GameMessage elements while preserving the constructed range.

applied.name: ReplayObjectReferenceVector_Reserve
applied.evidence: Grows the replay object-reference vector to the requested capacity.

applied.name: DebugString_AppendQuaternion
applied.evidence: Formats four floating-point quaternion components into the debug stream.

applied.name: DebugString_AppendVector3
applied.evidence: Formats three floating-point vector components into the debug stream.

applied.name: Xfer_Quaternion
applied.evidence: Transfers all four quaternion components through the xfer interface.

applied.name: ReplayCameraState_CopyFrom
applied.evidence: Copies the eight floating-point fields of one recovered replay camera state into another.

applied.name: BufferingControl_Ctor
applied.evidence: Initializes the BufferingControl vtable, counters, and configured limit.

applied.name: ReplayCameraController_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs eight per-player camera slots, creates the auxiliary camera object, and initializes replay camera controller state.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EnsureOutputStarted
applied.evidence: Starts the recording output immediately when requested or advances the asynchronous readiness path using the current slot state.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_BeginPostFinalizeWait
applied.evidence: Moves recording to state 7, records the wait timestamp, derives the retention/result class, and starts the post-finalization job.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_StartWriterJob
applied.evidence: Transitions the writer subcontext to state 2 and submits the output descriptor plus completed replay header to the writer job.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_BuildHeader
applied.evidence: Populates the complete replay header from channel order, version, match, map, player, mod, metadata, and current engine state.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_BuildOutputDescriptor
applied.evidence: Resolves automatic or explicit replay paths and constructs the owned output descriptor consumed by the writer job.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_InstallMapResources
applied.evidence: Resolves the replay map path and installs embedded map image, map.ini, assets, and related resources required before match initialization.
